test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 5 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is INCORRECT regarding the process of excretion in plants?

options.text: Waste products may be stored as resins and gums in old xylem.
Waste products may be stored in leaves that fall off.
Waste product of photosynthesis is stored as starch.
Waste products are stored in cellular vacuoles.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Waste product of photosynthesis is stored as starch.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The process of **excretion in plants** involves the **removal of waste products** that are produced during various **metabolic activities. **
 
• "Waste product of photosynthesis is stored as starch." statement is** incorrect.** 
 
• The waste product of photosynthesis is oxygen, while the** excess glucose** produced during the process is **stored as starch.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• **Resins and gums** are waste products that are stored in the** old xylem **of some plants.

 
 
• These substances are often used for** defense against predators **or as a means of sealing wounds.
 
 
 
• Some plants store waste products in the **leaves that fall off** during the autumn season.
 
 
• This helps to **conserve resources** and maintain the **overall health **of the plant.
 
 
 
• **Cellular vacuoles** are storage spaces in plants that can store various waste products, such as **excess salts, pigments, and metabolic byproducts**.
 
 
• These vacuoles also play a crucial role in maintaining** turgor pressure** and **regulating the pH of the cell.**
